receipt_movement_source_tieout: WITH movements AS (SELECT "referenceId" AS receipt_id,"itemId",SUM(quantity) AS quantity,SUM("totalCost") AS cost FROM inventory_transactions WHERE "referenceType"='GOODS_RECEIPT' GROUP BY "referenceId","itemId"), receipts AS (SELECT "goodsReceiptId" AS receipt_id,"itemId",SUM("receivedQuantity") AS quantity,SUM("lineTotal") AS cost FROM goods_receipt_lines GROUP BY "goodsReceiptId","itemId") SELECT m.receipt_id,m."itemId",g.status,m.quantity::text AS movement_quantity,r.quantity::text AS receipt_quantity,m.cost::text AS movement_cost,r.cost::text AS receipt_cost FROM movements m LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.receipt_id=m.receipt_id AND r."itemId"=m."itemId" JOIN goods_receipts g ON g.id=m.receipt_id WHERE r.receipt_id IS NULL OR ABS(m.quantity-r.quantity)>0.001 OR ABS(m.cost-r.cost)>0.01
posted_journal_balance: SELECT e.id,e.status,COUNT(l.id)::int AS lines,COALESCE(SUM(l.debit-l.credit),0)::text AS difference,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l."baseDebit",l.debit*l."exchangeRate")-COALESCE(l."baseCredit",l.credit*l."exchangeRate")),0)::text AS base_difference FROM journal_entries e LEFT JOIN journal_entry_lines l ON l."journalEntryId"=e.id WHERE e.status IN ('POSTED','REVERSED') GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(l.id)<2 OR ABS(COALESCE(SUM(l.debit-l.credit),0))>0.01 OR ABS(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(l."baseDebit",l.debit*l."exchangeRate")-COALESCE(l."baseCredit",l.credit*l."exchangeRate")),0))>0.01
journal_line_sides: SELECT id FROM journal_entry_lines WHERE debit<0 OR credit<0 OR (debit>0 AND credit>0) OR "baseDebit"<0 OR "baseCredit"<0 OR "exchangeRate"<=0
journal_currency_consistency: SELECT l.id FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN journal_entries e ON e.id=l."journalEntryId" WHERE l.currency<>e.currency
sales_line_arithmetic: SELECT id,"salesOrderId" FROM sales_order_lines WHERE quantity<=0 OR ABS("lineTotal"-(quantity*"unitPrice"-discount+"taxAmount"))>0.02
sales_header_line_tax: SELECT s.id,s.status FROM sales_orders s JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l."salesOrderId"=s.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING ABS(s."taxAmount"-SUM(l."taxAmount"))>0.02
supplier_invoice_header_arithmetic: SELECT id,status FROM supplier_invoices WHERE ABS(total-(subtotal+"taxAmount"-discount))>0.01 OR "amountPaid"<0 OR "amountPaid">total
supplier_invoice_line_arithmetic: SELECT id,"supplierInvoiceId" FROM supplier_invoice_lines WHERE quantity<=0 OR ABS("lineTotal"-(quantity*"unitCost"+"taxAmount"))>0.02
supplier_invoice_line_totals: SELECT s.id,s.status FROM supplier_invoices s JOIN supplier_invoice_lines l ON l."supplierInvoiceId"=s.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING ABS(s."taxAmount"-SUM(l."taxAmount"))>0.02 OR ABS(s.subtotal-SUM(l.quantity*l."unitCost"))>0.02
payroll_run_arithmetic: SELECT id,status FROM payroll_runs WHERE ABS("netPayableAmount"-("grossAmount"-"employeeDeductionAmount"))>0.01 OR "grossAmount"<0 OR "employeeDeductionAmount"<0 OR "employerChargeAmount"<0 OR "netPayableAmount"<0
payroll_run_line_arithmetic: SELECT id,"payrollRunId" FROM payroll_run_lines WHERE ABS("netPayableAmount"-("grossAmount"-"employeeDeductionAmount"))>0.01 OR "grossAmount"<0 OR "employeeDeductionAmount"<0 OR "employerChargeAmount"<0 OR "netPayableAmount"<0
payroll_run_line_totals: SELECT r.id,r.status FROM payroll_runs r JOIN payroll_run_lines l ON l."payrollRunId"=r.id GROUP BY r.id HAVING ABS(r."grossAmount"-SUM(l."grossAmount"))>0.01 OR ABS(r."employeeDeductionAmount"-SUM(l."employeeDeductionAmount"))>0.01 OR ABS(r."employerChargeAmount"-SUM(l."employerChargeAmount"))>0.01 OR ABS(r."netPayableAmount"-SUM(l."netPayableAmount"))>0.01
payslip_run_line_totals: SELECT p.id FROM payroll_payslips p JOIN payroll_run_lines l ON l.id=p."runLineId" WHERE ABS(p."grossAmount"-l."grossAmount")>0.01 OR ABS(p."employeeDeductionAmount"-l."employeeDeductionAmount")>0.01 OR ABS(p."employerChargeAmount"-l."employerChargeAmount")>0.01 OR ABS(p."netPayableAmount"-l."netPayableAmount")>0.01
payment_refund_bounds: SELECT id,status FROM payments WHERE amount<0 OR "refundedAmount"<0 OR "refundedAmount">amount
signed_reconciliation_proof: SELECT id FROM reconciliation_runs WHERE status='SIGNED' AND ("signedById" IS NULL OR "signedAt" IS NULL)
receipt_source_details: SELECT t.id AS "movementId",t."referenceId" AS "goodsReceiptId",t."itemId",t."locationId",g."organizationId",g.status,g."purchaseOrderId",g."receiptDate",t.quantity::text AS "movementQuantity",t."unitCost"::text AS "movementUnitCost",t."totalCost"::text AS "movementCost",l.id AS "receiptLineId",l."purchaseOrderLineId",l."receivedQuantity"::text AS "receiptQuantity",l."unitCost"::text AS "receiptUnitCost",l."lineTotal"::text AS "receiptCost" FROM inventory_transactions t JOIN goods_receipts g ON g.id=t."referenceId" LEFT JOIN goods_receipt_lines l ON l."goodsReceiptId"=g.id AND l."itemId"=t."itemId" WHERE t."referenceType"='GOODS_RECEIPT' AND (l.id IS NULL OR ABS(t.quantity-l."receivedQuantity")>0.001 OR ABS(t."totalCost"-l."lineTotal")>0.01) ORDER BY t.id,l.id
sales_source_details: SELECT s.id AS "salesOrderId",s."organizationId",s.status,s.channel,s."orderDate",s."locationId",s.subtotal::text,s."taxAmount"::text AS "headerTax",s.discount::text AS "headerDiscount",s.total::text AS "headerTotal",l.id AS "salesOrderLineId",l."itemId",l.quantity::text,l."unitPrice"::text,l.discount::text,l."taxRate"::text,l."taxAmount"::text AS "lineTax",l."lineTotal"::text,(l.quantity*l."unitPrice"-l.discount+l."taxAmount")::text AS "expectedLineTotal" FROM sales_orders s JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l."salesOrderId"=s.id WHERE ABS(l."lineTotal"-(l.quantity*l."unitPrice"-l.discount+l."taxAmount"))>0.02 OR ABS(s."taxAmount"-(SELECT SUM(x."taxAmount") FROM sales_order_lines x WHERE x."salesOrderId"=s.id))>0.02 ORDER BY s.id,l.id
missing_stock_events: WITH expected AS (SELECT t.*,CASE WHEN t."referenceType"='STOCK_TRANSFER' THEN 'STOCK_TRANSFER' WHEN t."referenceType"='STOCK_ADJUSTMENT' THEN 'STOCK_ADJUSTMENT' WHEN t."referenceType"='GOODS_RECEIPT' THEN 'GOODS_RECEIPT' WHEN t."referenceType"='PRODUCTION_BATCH' THEN 'PRODUCTION_BATCH' WHEN t."referenceType"='MANUAL' AND t.type='INITIAL_STOCK' THEN 'OPENING_BALANCE' WHEN t."referenceType"='MANUAL' AND t.type IN ('ADJUSTMENT_IN','ADJUSTMENT_OUT','DAMAGED','EXPIRED','THEFT','WRITE_OFF','SAMPLE','PROMOTION') THEN 'STOCK_ADJUSTMENT' WHEN t."referenceType"='SALES_ORDER' AND t.type='SALE' THEN 'POS_SALE' WHEN t."referenceType" IN ('SALES_ORDER','RETURN') AND t.type='SALES_RETURN' THEN 'POS_REFUND' END AS expected FROM inventory_transactions t JOIN items i ON i.id=t."itemId" WHERE t."referenceId" IS NOT NULL AND t."recordedAt"<=transaction_timestamp() AND t."effectiveAt"<=transaction_timestamp()) SELECT e.id AS "inventoryTransactionId",e."organizationId",e.type,e."referenceType",e."referenceId",e."itemId",e."locationId",e.expected AS "expectedSourceType",e.quantity::text,e."totalCost"::text,e."createdAt" FROM expected e WHERE e.expected IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_events b WHERE b."organizationId"=e."organizationId" AND b."sourceType"::text=e.expected AND b."sourceId"=e."referenceId" AND b."recordedAt"<=transaction_timestamp()) ORDER BY e.id
item_stock: SELECT i.id,i."organizationId",i."isActive",i."trackInventory",i."unitId",i."taxRateId",COUNT(l.id)::int AS "levelCount",COALESCE(SUM(l."quantityOnHand"),0)::text AS "onHand",COALESCE(SUM(l."quantityAvailable"),0)::text AS available,COALESCE(SUM(l."totalValue"),0)::text AS value FROM items i LEFT JOIN inventory_levels l ON l."itemId"=i.id GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY i."organizationId",i.id
inventory_availability: SELECT id,"itemId","locationId" FROM inventory_levels WHERE "quantityAvailable"<>"quantityOnHand"-"quantityReserved" OR "quantityReserved"<0 OR "quantityAvailable"<0 ORDER BY id
inventory_valuation: SELECT id,"itemId","locationId" FROM inventory_levels WHERE ABS("totalValue"-ROUND("quantityOnHand"*"averageCost",2))>0.01 ORDER BY id
inventory_movement_drift: SELECT l.id,l."itemId",l."locationId",l."quantityOnHand"::text,COALESCE(t.quantity,0)::text AS "movementQuantity" FROM inventory_levels l LEFT JOIN(SELECT "itemId","locationId",SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM inventory_transactions GROUP BY "itemId","locationId") t ON t."itemId"=l."itemId" AND t."locationId"=l."locationId" WHERE l."quantityOnHand"<>COALESCE(t.quantity,0) ORDER BY l.id
inventory_ledger_tieout: WITH stock AS(SELECT i."organizationId",SUM(l."totalValue") value FROM inventory_levels l JOIN items i ON i.id=l."itemId" GROUP BY i."organizationId"), movement AS(SELECT i."organizationId",SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PURCHASE_RECEIPT','SALES_RETURN','TRANSFER_IN','ADJUSTMENT_IN','PRODUCTION_IN','INITIAL_STOCK','RESERVATION_RELEASE') THEN t."totalCost" WHEN t.type IN ('SALE','PURCHASE_RETURN','TRANSFER_OUT','ADJUSTMENT_OUT','PRODUCTION_OUT','DAMAGED','EXPIRED','THEFT','WRITE_OFF','SAMPLE','PROMOTION','RESERVATION') THEN -ABS(t."totalCost") ELSE 0 END) value FROM inventory_transactions t JOIN items i ON i.id=t."itemId" WHERE t."recordedAt"<=transaction_timestamp() AND t."effectiveAt"<=transaction_timestamp() GROUP BY i."organizationId"), ledger AS(SELECT e."organizationId",e.currency,SUM(l.debit-l.credit) value FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN journal_entries e ON e.id=l."journalEntryId" JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id=l."accountId" WHERE e.status IN ('POSTED','REVERSED') AND a."syscohadaClass" LIKE '3%' AND a."isActive"=true AND a."organizationId"=e."organizationId" AND l."organizationId"=e."organizationId" AND l.currency=e.currency AND e."postedAt"<=transaction_timestamp() AND e."entryDate"<=transaction_timestamp() GROUP BY e."organizationId",e.currency) SELECT s."organizationId",g.currency,s.value::text AS "projectionValue",m.value::text AS "movementValue",g.value::text AS "class3Value",(m.value-g.value)::text AS "movementLedgerDrift",(s.value-m.value)::text AS "projectionMovementDrift" FROM stock s LEFT JOIN movement m USING("organizationId") LEFT JOIN ledger g USING("organizationId") ORDER BY s."organizationId",g.currency
item_reference_issues: SELECT i.id,i."organizationId",i."unitId",i."taxRateId" FROM items i LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id=i."unitId" LEFT JOIN tax_rates t ON t.id=i."taxRateId" WHERE u.id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL OR u."organizationId"<>i."organizationId" OR t."organizationId"<>i."organizationId" ORDER BY i.id
nullable_base_amount_snapshots: SELECT id,"journalEntryId" FROM journal_entry_lines WHERE "baseDebit" IS NULL OR "baseCredit" IS NULL ORDER BY id
generic_PayrollRunLine_calculationSnapsh: SELECT "id","organizationId","payrollRunId","employeeId","contractId","attendanceSnapshotId","currency","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "payroll_run_lines" WHERE jsonb_typeof("calculationSnapshot"::jsonb)='object' AND "calculationSnapshot"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("calculationSnapshot"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_PayrollRunLine_ruleProvenance: SELECT "id","organizationId","payrollRunId","employeeId","contractId","attendanceSnapshotId","currency","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "payroll_run_lines" WHERE jsonb_typeof("ruleProvenance"::jsonb)='object' AND "ruleProvenance"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("ruleProvenance"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_POSOfflineEvent_payload: SELECT "id","organizationId","deviceId","terminalId","locationId","sessionId","syncBatchId","businessEventId","eventType","schemaVersion","status","postingBatchId","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "pos_offline_events" WHERE jsonb_typeof("payload"::jsonb)='object' AND "payload"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("payload"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_ProviderEvent_rawPayload: SELECT "id","organizationId","providerAccountId","eventType","status","signatureValid","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "provider_events" WHERE jsonb_typeof("rawPayload"::jsonb)='object' AND "rawPayload"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("rawPayload"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_BusinessEvent_payload: SELECT "id","organizationId","eventType","schemaVersion","status","locationId","deviceId","sourceType","sourceId","postingBatchId","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "business_events" WHERE jsonb_typeof("payload"::jsonb)='object' AND "payload"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("payload"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_BusinessEventOutbox_payload: SELECT "id","organizationId","businessEventId","channel","eventName","status","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "business_event_outbox" WHERE jsonb_typeof("payload"::jsonb)='object' AND "payload"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("payload"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_FiscalDocument_canonicalPayload: SELECT "id","organizationId","documentType","status","sourceType","sourceId","sourceNumber","sourceDate","postingBatchId","journalEntryId","accountingSourceLinkId","countryCode","countryPackVersion","countryPackSchemaVersion","countryPackResolutionHash","countryPackLegalRef","countryPackVerificationStatus","currency","authorityChannel","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "fiscal_documents" WHERE jsonb_typeof("canonicalPayload"::jsonb)='object' AND "canonicalPayload"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("canonicalPayload"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
generic_WorkflowAssuranceCheckDefinition: SELECT "id","checkKey","version","workflow","moduleSlug","invariantName","executionMode","defaultSeverity","requiredPermission","ownerRole","enabled","enforceMode","actionRoute","createdAt","updatedAt" FROM "workflow_assurance_check_definitions" WHERE jsonb_typeof("sourceTables"::jsonb)='object' AND "sourceTables"::jsonb->>'seed'='true' AND ("sourceTables"::jsonb - ARRAY['seed','model','index','organizationId','businessEventId','employeeId','countryPack','provisionalReference'])='{}'::jsonb ORDER BY id
